SIGN_IN.INTRO: Brings your open Microsoft To Do lists, tasks, steps, notes, due dates and repeats into Super Productivity. The import only adds data — nothing in Super Productivity is changed or removed.
SIGN_IN.HELP: You sign in with Microsoft in a browser window. The import asks only to read your tasks; the access is used for this import and then forgotten.
SIGN_IN.LOADING: Loading your Microsoft To Do data…
SIGN_IN.NO_LISTS: No lists found for this Microsoft account.
SIGN_IN.NOT_CONFIGURED: This build has no Microsoft sign-in configured.
SIGN_IN.LEGAL: Microsoft keeps your permission until you revoke it in your Microsoft account. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft; Microsoft provides no warranty and accepts no liability for this import.

ERROR.LOAD_FAILED: Could not load data from Microsoft To Do: {{error}} — try signing in again and check your connection.
ERROR.IMPORT_STOPPED: Import stopped at “{{project}}”: {{error}}. That project was created only partially — delete “{{project}}” before re-running, then select it and the remaining lists again.

PREVIEW.CHOOSE_PROJECTS: Choose the lists to import — each becomes a project:
PREVIEW.LOSS_HEADING: What will not survive the move
PREVIEW.SELECT_PROJECT: Select at least one list to import.

LOSS.RECURRING: Repeats that Super Productivity cannot express (the rule is noted in task notes): {{count}}.
LOSS.ATTACHMENTS: Tasks with file attachments, imported without the files: {{count}}.
LOSS.TRUNCATED_FIELDS: Unusually long values shortened to safe import limits: {{count}}.
LOSS.ALWAYS: Completed tasks, My Day and linked emails or files are not imported.

SUMMARY.SHORTFALL: some items did not land; please review
SUMMARY.UNVERIFIED: Could not verify the imported counts — the numbers above may show 0 even for tasks that landed.
SUMMARY.REPEATS_FAILED: Recurring tasks that could not be set to repeat (the rule is noted in task notes): {{count}}.
SUMMARY.UNDO: The import is additive — to undo it, delete the created projects.
